summary: C3is Inc. filed a Form 6-K for May 2026, reporting unaudited Q1 2026 financial results via a press release. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial and operating results, not a special situation. It includes share count and outstanding convertible preferred stock and warrants as of May 15, 2026, but no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. No event triggers a special-situation category; thus, the appropriate classification is None.
